meta.description: One-on-one heart coherence coaching with biofeedback, to move past chronic stress and burnout. A 6-week programme in Wallonia, Belgium.

hero.title:
Your heart has its own rhythm.
Learn to find it again.
hero.lead: One-on-one heart coherence coaching with biofeedback. A measurable 6-week programme to move past chronic stress — no medical jargon, with a concrete result from the first session.

pourquoi.heading: Why the heart
pourquoi.p1: Do you feel tense, overwhelmed, or worn out without quite knowing why? Have you already tried "breathing exercises" without ever knowing if they actually worked?
pourquoi.p2: Heart coherence starts from a simple principle: your heart rate constantly varies, and that variability (HRV) reflects the state of your autonomic nervous system. By breathing at a precise rate — your own, measured individually — you can shift that system toward a physiological state of calm. With a biofeedback device, you watch that state form in real time, session after session.
pourquoi.p3: This is not therapy and not a medical treatment. It's a concrete, measurable practice you take with you.

cards.title: Your resonance frequency
cards.text: From the first session, we identify your optimal breathing rate — typically between 4.5 and 7 breaths per minute. That's the starting point of the whole programme.

cards.title: Immediate visual feedback
cards.text: The biofeedback device (emWave Pro) shows your coherence state in real time. You don't have to "believe" it's working — you see it.

cards.title: An evidence-based method
cards.text: Heart coherence with biofeedback is the most studied form of biofeedback for stress and wellbeing, with effectiveness comparable to mindfulness meditation on perceived stress.

parcours.heading: The programme
parcours.lead: Six weeks, six sessions. A pace designed to let you integrate the practice between sessions, not cram it in.

steps.title: Intake session — 1h
steps.text: We review your situation and goals, and measure your individual resonance frequency.

steps.title: 5 one-on-one sessions — 1h each
steps.text: Each session builds on the biofeedback practice, based on what did or didn't work since the last one.

tarif.heading: Pricing
tarif.note: Limited number of programmes each week — slots are assigned in the order requests come in.

pourqui.heading: Who this is for
pourqui.p1: This programme is for adults going through a period of prolonged stress or exhaustion, who are looking for a concrete tool rather than yet another general relaxation technique.
pourqui.p2: This is not medical or psychological care. If you're already being treated for burnout or another health issue, this programme is a complement to — never a replacement for — your medical care.

items.a: No. This is coaching / wellness support, based on a breathing and biofeedback method. It does not replace medical or psychological care.
